description: This PHP class defines the LDAPUserLookupSetting, a configuration object for LDAP user lookup within an OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It manages LDAP search parameters such as base DN, search scope, user attributes, and mapping settings.

classes.name: LDAPUserLookupSetting
classes.description: Configuration class for LDAP user lookup settings, including scope, attributes, filters, and mapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LDAPUserLookupSetting with a base distinguished name (DN) and default mapping.

methods.name: getBaseDN
methods.description: Returns the base distinguished name for LDAP searches.

methods.name: getSearchScope
methods.description: Returns the LDAP search scope setting.

methods.name: setSearchScope
methods.description: Sets the LDAP search scope with validation against allowed values.

methods.name: getUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP attribute used for the username.

methods.name: setUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute used for the username.

methods.name: getUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP attribute used for the user's unique ID.

methods.name: setUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute used for the user's unique ID.

methods.name: getUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Gets the LDAP search filter used for user lookup.

methods.name: setUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Sets the LDAP search filter used for user lookup.

methods.name: getEmployeeSelectorMapping
methods.description: Returns the LDAP employee selector mapping object.

methods.name: setEmployeeSelectorMapping
methods.description: Sets the LDAP employee selector mapping object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the LDAPUserLookupSetting to an associative array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance from an associative array of settings.
